messages:
ashley: noticing increased apiserver watch backlog in asia-south1 since 02:15 UTC, correlates with GPU attach storm from batch onboards
ashley: apiserver p95 latency up ~120ms, controller-manager queue length growing :eyes:
kyle: logs show a bunch of `WATCH` reconnects and grpc errors to etcd follower replicas
maria: can you paste the small log snippet?
ashley: `2026-03-21T02:16:03Z apiserver watch error: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing`
ashok: also seeing `etcdserver: request took too long` on follower nodes, IO iowait bump on nvme in that region
ashley: looks like attach + kube-controller churn -> watch fanout spike -> etcd IO spike -> apiserver blocks on watch writes
kyle: hypothesis: GPU attach bursts create many new pods and node events, watch-cache gets hotkeys causing excessive fanout to SAs/ingress controllers
maria: short-term mitigation: can we throttle attach parallelism for onboarding job and reduce controller-manager burst concurrency?
ashley: started throttling onboarding job to 5 parallel attaches (was 30) and applied `--controllers=...` tweak on canary controller-manager to lower concurrency for a few minutes
ashok: also bumped apiserver `--max-requests-inflight` down to reduce tail amplification, rolling one apiserver at a time
deploy-bot: rolling update initiated for apiserver deployment in asia-south1 by ashley
ashley: initial metrics: etcd disk iops down ~40% after throttling, watch backlog trending down but still elevated
maria: mid-term: consider KV-compaction cadence and smaller snapshot thresholds in that region to lower WAL churn during spikes
kyle: long-term: we should evaluate routing GPU onboards to different AZs to smooth attached churn vs concentrating on a single AZ for cost reasons
ashok: cost tradeoff: spreading onboards increases cross-AZ egress and may hit network egress budget; we need to model cost vs reliability
maria: I'll run a quick cost model for spreading onboards vs delayed batch in same AZ and post results here by EOD
ashley: for now, we have apiserver stable at p95 ~90ms and controller queue decreasing, watching for regression :thumbsup:
kyle: created issue #INFRA-1329 to track: "asia-south1 GPU attach -> apiserver watch backlog; mitigations; cost model"
ashok: +1, add notes about compaction changes and controller-manager concurrency in the issue
deploy-bot: scheduled rollback window open until 03:30 UTC if rollback needed
maria: thanks all, I'll update with cost numbers and proposed config changes
ashley: great work. if anything spikes again, @kyle and @ashok please ping SRE oncall and we can revert throttles quickly
ashok: ack
kyle: ack :eyes:
